chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn Umayra, from Bakr ibn Abi Bakr, from Zurara ibn Ayn, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Glorification of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) is from the Abundant Remembrance of which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, spoke: 'Mention Allah with a frequent Mentioning.'

key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ الزَّهْرَاءُ: Fatima al-Zahra, the daughter of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What is the Quranic basis for the Tasbih of Fatima al-Zahra?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi explicitly identifies the Tasbih of Fatima al-Zahra as the specific manifestation of 'Dhikr al-Kathir' (Abundant Remembrance) commanded in the Quran, thereby elevating its status from a recommended practice to one with direct scriptural warrant. By linking this devotional act to the verse in Surah Al-Ahzab, Shia scholarship underscores its role in spiritual purification and its connection to the Ahl al-Bayt's exemplary piety. The chain of narration, featuring key figures like Zurara and Abu Abdullah (Imam al-Sadiq), reinforces its authenticity within the Usuli tradition.
